title: Director Real Estate Assessments Division

title: Neighborhood Development Planner
employer: James City County, Virginia (Community Development Department)
description: Manages federal/state/local grant funding (including CDBG) and provides project management for affordable-housing development projects, including budgets, contracts and stakeholder engagement.
requirements: Any combination of education and experience equivalent to a bachelor's degree with major course work in planning, real estate, public or business administration, or related field; AICP and/or considerable experience in property acquisition, community development, and management are preferred.

Knowledge of County and departmental goals and policy as well as federal, state, and local laws, rules and regulations governing affordable housing; community development; real estate law and practice; construction methods, procurement; federal labor standards; zoning; planning and code enforcement; principles and practices of administrative management; fiscal and budgetary principles; and leadership techniques.
Skill in use of computer software including Microsoft Office Suite and ArcGIS Pro.

Ability to work with citizen groups to explain complicated projects, obtain useful feedback, develop consensus, and obtain commitments for participation; negotiate fair and favorable property acquisition contracts; communicate effectively orally and in writing; establish and maintain professional working relationships.
Must possess, or be able to obtain within 30 days of hire, a valid Virginia driver's license and have an acceptable driving record based on James City County's criteria.
